RustyShelf 0.6.6 shows a theme on your shelf as you pick it, puts every change of a version in a bigger, colourful What's new, and gives the disc out of its case a real edge and underside.

## New

- **Theme preview.** In Settings → Look, the page fades for a moment each time you change the theme, so you see it on your shelf behind; the Theme row stays readable, and changing it again and again keeps the page faded until you stop. ([#8](https://github.com/zearkreast/rustyshelf/issues/8))
- **What's new.** After an update, a bigger card shows the version's changes under New, Changed and Fixed, each in its own colour; All the notes opens the rest. Settings → System → What's new lists every version under its own heading, a row per change, with what it is in the side card. ([#9](https://github.com/zearkreast/rustyshelf/issues/9))

## Fixed

- **The disc in Inspect** has a thickness, an edge and the wall of its hole, and its underside looks like a disc's: the tint of its format, its tracks, the mirror band round the middle, clear plastic at the hole and the rim, and a faint rainbow sheen.
- **A disc or cartridge turned in Inspect** comes forward as it turns, so it no longer passes into the case or the open lid.

## Download

| | File | |
|---|---|---|
| **Windows** | `RustyShelf-0.6.6-windows-setup.exe` | The installer. |
| | `RustyShelf-0.6.6-windows.zip` | The app and its `data` folder, to unzip anywhere. `--windowed` starts it in a window. |
| **Linux** | `RustyShelf-0.6.6-linux.AppImage` | `chmod +x` it once, then start it. |
| **Android** | `RustyShelf-0.6.6-android.apk` | arm64. Installs over 0.6.x. |

`SHA256SUMS.txt` has each file's SHA-256 sum.

The manual lists [everything that works](https://github.com/zearkreast/rustyshelf/blob/rustyshelf/docs/MANUAL.md#what-works). Found a problem? [Open an issue](https://github.com/zearkreast/rustyshelf/issues).
